swords-dance.name: Swords Dance
swords-dance.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

vine-whip.name: Vine Whip
vine-whip.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

tackle.name: Tackle
tackle.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

body-slam.name: Body Slam
body-slam.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

take-down.name: Take Down
take-down.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

double-edge.name: Double-Edge
double-edge.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

growl.name: Growl
growl.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

leech-seed.name: Leech Seed
leech-seed.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

growth.name: Growth
growth.description: The user’s body grows all at once, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

razor-leaf.name: Razor Leaf
razor-leaf.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

solar-beam.name: Solar Beam
solar-beam.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

poison-powder.name: Poison Powder
poison-powder.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

sleep-powder.name: Sleep Powder
sleep-powder.description: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

light-screen.name: Light Screen
light-screen.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

rest.name: Rest
rest.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

protect.name: Protect
protect.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludge-bomb.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

mud-slap.name: Mud-Slap
mud-slap.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

giga-drain.name: Giga Drain
giga-drain.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

endure.name: Endure
endure.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

charm.name: Charm
charm.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target’s Attack stat.

false-swipe.name: False Swipe
false-swipe.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

sleep-talk.name: Sleep Talk
sleep-talk.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

sweet-scent.name: Sweet Scent
sweet-scent.description: A sweet scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

sunny-day.name: Sunny Day
sunny-day.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

facade.name: Facade
facade.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

helping-hand.name: Helping Hand
helping-hand.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally’s attack.

knock-off.name: Knock Off
knock-off.description: The user slaps down the target’s held item, and that item can’t be used in that battle. The move does more damage if the target has a held item.

weather-ball.name: Weather Ball
weather-ball.description: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.

bullet-seed.name: Bullet Seed
bullet-seed.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two to five times in a row.

magical-leaf.name: Magical Leaf
magical-leaf.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

worry-seed.name: Worry Seed
worry-seed.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target’s Ability Insomnia.

seed-bomb.name: Seed Bomb
seed-bomb.description: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

energy-ball.name: Energy Ball
energy-ball.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

leaf-storm.name: Leaf Storm
leaf-storm.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

power-whip.name: Power Whip
power-whip.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

grass-knot.name: Grass Knot
grass-knot.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

acid-spray.name: Acid Spray
acid-spray.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

grass-pledge.name: Grass Pledge
grass-pledge.description: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water equivalent, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.

grassy-terrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassy-terrain.description: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

grassy-glide.name: Grassy Glide
grassy-glide.description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

tera-blast.name: Tera Blast
tera-blast.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

roar.name: Roar
roar.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

hyper-beam.name: Hyper Beam
hyper-beam.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

scary-face.name: Scary Face
scary-face.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

frenzy-plant.name: Frenzy Plant
frenzy-plant.description: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

poison-jab.name: Poison Jab
poison-jab.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

earth-power.name: Earth Power
earth-power.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

giga-impact.name: Giga Impact
giga-impact.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

petal-blizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
petal-blizzard.description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

stomping-tantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stomping-tantrum.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

fire-punch.name: Fire Punch
fire-punch.description: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This may also leave the target with a burn.

thunder-punch.name: Thunder Punch
thunder-punch.description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

scratch.name: Scratch
scratch.description: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

leer.name: Leer
leer.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers the Defense stat.

ember.name: Ember
ember.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

dragon-rage.name: Dragon Rage
dragon-rage.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

fire-spin.name: Fire Spin
fire-spin.description: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

dig.name: Dig
dig.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

fire-blast.name: Fire Blast
fire-blast.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

swift.name: Swift
swift.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

fury-swipes.name: Fury Swipes
fury-swipes.description: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes quickly two to five times in a row.

rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
rock-slide.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

slash.name: Slash
slash.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

dragon-breath.name: Dragon Breath
dragon-breath.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

metal-claw.name: Metal Claw
metal-claw.description: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

heat-wave.name: Heat Wave
heat-wave.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

will-o-wisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
will-o-wisp.description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

focus-punch.name: Focus Punch
focus-punch.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

brick-break.name: Brick Break
brick-break.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

rock-tomb.name: Rock Tomb
rock-tomb.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

aerial-ace.name: Aerial Ace
aerial-ace.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

dragon-claw.name: Dragon Claw
dragon-claw.description: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

dragon-dance.name: Dragon Dance
dragon-dance.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

fling.name: Fling
fling.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

flare-blitz.name: Flare Blitz
flare-blitz.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.

dragon-pulse.name: Dragon Pulse
dragon-pulse.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

focus-blast.name: Focus Blast
focus-blast.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

shadow-claw.name: Shadow Claw
shadow-claw.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

fire-fang.name: Fire Fang
fire-fang.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

flame-burst.name: Flame Burst
flame-burst.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

flame-charge.name: Flame Charge
flame-charge.description: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up more power, the user raises its Speed stat.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

fire-pledge.name: Fire Pledge
fire-pledge.description: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass equivalent, its power increases and a vast sea of fire appears.

dragon-tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon-tail.description: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

breaking-swipe.name: Breaking Swipe
breaking-swipe.description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

temper-flare.name: Temper Flare
temper-flare.description: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

wing-attack.name: Wing Attack
wing-attack.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

fly.name: Fly
fly.description: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

blast-burn.name: Blast Burn
blast-burn.description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can’t move on the next turn.

air-cutter.name: Air Cutter
air-cutter.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

air-slash.name: Air Slash
air-slash.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

heat-crash.name: Heat Crash
heat-crash.description: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

scorching-sands.name: Scorching Sands
scorching-sands.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

dragon-cheer.name: Dragon Cheer
dragon-cheer.description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

ice-punch.name: Ice Punch
ice-punch.description: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target frozen.

tail-whip.name: Tail Whip
tail-whip.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stats.

bite.name: Bite
bite.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

water-gun.name: Water Gun
water-gun.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

hydro-pump.name: Hydro Pump
hydro-pump.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

surf.name: Surf
surf.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

ice-beam.name: Ice Beam
ice-beam.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

bubble-beam.name: Bubble Beam
bubble-beam.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

haze.name: Haze
haze.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

skull-bash.name: Skull Bash
skull-bash.description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

icy-wind.name: Icy Wind
icy-wind.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
rapid-spin.description: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also raises the user’s Speed stat.

rain-dance.name: Rain Dance
rain-dance.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.description: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

follow-me.name: Follow Me
follow-me.description: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

muddy-water.name: Muddy Water
muddy-water.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

iron-defense.name: Iron Defense
iron-defense.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

mud-shot.name: Mud Shot
mud-shot.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

water-pulse.name: Water Pulse
water-pulse.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

gyro-ball.name: Gyro Ball
gyro-ball.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.

aura-sphere.name: Aura Sphere
aura-sphere.description: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

aqua-tail.name: Aqua Tail
aqua-tail.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zen-headbutt.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

scald.name: Scald
scald.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

shell-smash.name: Shell Smash
shell-smash.description: The user breaks its shell, which lowers Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raises its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

water-pledge.name: Water Pledge
water-pledge.description: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire equivalent, its power increases and a rainbow appears.

liquidation.name: Liquidation
liquidation.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

flip-turn.name: Flip Turn
flip-turn.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

wave-crash.name: Wave Crash
wave-crash.description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

ice-spinner.name: Ice Spinner
ice-spinner.description: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

chilling-water.name: Chilling Water
chilling-water.description: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

hydro-cannon.name: Hydro Cannon
hydro-cannon.description: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can’t move on the next turn.

dark-pulse.name: Dark Pulse
dark-pulse.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

flash-cannon.name: Flash Cannon
flash-cannon.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

smack-down.name: Smack Down
smack-down.description: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when it’s hit.

body-press.name: Body Press
body-press.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

string-shot.name: String Shot
string-shot.description: Opposing Pokémon are bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth that harshly lowers the Speed stat.

bug-bite.name: Bug Bite
bug-bite.description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

electroweb.name: Electroweb
electroweb.description: The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stats.

harden.name: Harden
harden.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

gust.name: Gust
gust.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

supersonic.name: Supersonic
supersonic.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

psybeam.name: Psybeam
psybeam.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also leave the target confused.

stun-spore.name: Stun Spore
stun-spore.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. This may also confuse the target.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.

baton-pass.name: Baton Pass
baton-pass.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

psych-up.name: Psych Up
psych-up.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

shadow-ball.name: Shadow Ball
shadow-ball.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

skill-swap.name: Skill Swap
skill-swap.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

silver-wind.name: Silver Wind
silver-wind.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed stats of the user and its allies for four turns.

u-turn.name: U-turn
u-turn.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

bug-buzz.name: Bug Buzz
bug-buzz.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

captivate.name: Captivate
captivate.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

rage-powder.name: Rage Powder
rage-powder.description: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.

quiver-dance.name: Quiver Dance
quiver-dance.description: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

struggle-bug.name: Struggle Bug
struggle-bug.description: While resisting, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. This lowers the Sp. Atk stats of those hit.

draining-kiss.name: Draining Kiss
draining-kiss.description: The user steals the target’s HP with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.

pollen-puff.name: Pollen Puff
pollen-puff.description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

poison-sting.name: Poison Sting
poison-sting.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

fury-attack.name: Fury Attack
fury-attack.description: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

pin-missile.name: Pin Missile
pin-missile.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

peck.name: Peck
peck.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

agility.name: Agility
agility.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

focus-energy.name: Focus Energy
focus-energy.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

fury-cutter.name: Fury Cutter
fury-cutter.description: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.description: This attack move cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

assurance.name: Assurance
assurance.description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

toxic-spikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxic-spikes.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

x-scissor.name: X-Scissor
x-scissor.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

drill-run.name: Drill Run
drill-run.description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

fell-stinger.name: Fell Stinger
fell-stinger.description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat rises drastically.

laser-focus.name: Laser Focus

razor-wind.name: Razor Wind
razor-wind.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

sand-attack.name: Sand Attack
sand-attack.description: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, reducing the target’s accuracy.

quick-attack.name: Quick Attack
quick-attack.description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.

mirror-move.name: Mirror Move

twister.name: Twister

feather-dance.name: Feather Dance

sky-attack.name: Sky Attack

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt

thunder-wave.name: Thunder Wave

thunder.name: Thunder

hyper-fang.name: Hyper Fang
hyper-fang.description: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

super-fang.name: Super Fang
super-fang.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

taunt.name: Taunt

charge-beam.name: Charge Beam

wild-charge.name: Wild Charge

drill-peck.name: Drill Peck

wrap.name: Wrap

acid.name: Acid

screech.name: Screech

poison-tail.name: Poison Tail

gastro-acid.name: Gastro Acid

gunk-shot.name: Gunk Shot

sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave

snarl.name: Snarl

belch.name: Belch

psychic-fangs.name: Psychic Fangs

scale-shot.name: Scale Shot

skitter-smack.name: Skitter Smack

lash-out.name: Lash Out
lash-out.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user’s stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.

slam.name: Slam
slam.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

pain-split.name: Pain Split

assist.description: Attacks randomly with one of the partner’s moves.

headlong-rush.name: Headlong Rush
headlong-rush.description: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s defensive stats.

metal-burst.name: Metal Burst
metal-burst.description: The user retaliates against the foe that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power.

tail-glow.name: Tail Glow
tail-glow.description: Flashes a light that sharply raises SP. ATK.

teeter-dance.name: Teeter Dance
teeter-dance.description: Confuses all POKéMON on the scene.

noble-roar.name: Noble Roar
noble-roar.description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

needle-arm.name: Needle Arm
needle-arm.description: Attacks with thorny arms. May cause flinching.

power-trip.name: Power Trip
power-trip.description: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the move’s power.

spiky-shield.name: Spiky Shield
spiky-shield.description: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker who makes direct contact.

magic-room.name: Magic Room
magic-room.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.

ice-ball.name: Ice Ball
ice-ball.description: A 5-turn attack that gains power on successive hits.

simple-beam.name: Simple Beam
simple-beam.description: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.

origin-pulse.name: Origin Pulse
origin-pulse.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

precipice-blades.name: Precipice Blades
precipice-blades.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

defog.name: Defog
defog.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

dragon-ascent.name: Dragon Ascent
dragon-ascent.description: After soaring upward, the user attacks its target by dropping out of the sky at high speeds, although it lowers its own Defense and Sp. Def in the process.

attack-order.name: Attack Order
attack-order.description: A une chance augmentée de coup critique.

defend-order.name: Defend Order
defend-order.description: Augmente la Défense et la Défense Spéciale du lanceur d'un niveau.

heal-order.name: Heal Order
heal-order.description: Soigne le lanceur de la moitié de ses PV max.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.description: A une plus grande chance de rendre la cible confuse quand le son enregistré est plus fort.

rock-wrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rock-wrecker.description: Le lanceur passe son prochain tour pour se recharger.

roar-of-time.name: Roar of Time
roar-of-time.description: Le lanceur passe son prochain tour pour se recharger.

spacial-rend.name: Spacial Rend
spacial-rend.description: A une chance augmentée de coup critique.

magma-storm.name: Magma Storm
magma-storm.description: Empêche la cible de fuir et inflige des dégâts pendant 2-5 tours.

crush-grip.name: Crush Grip
crush-grip.description: La puissance augmente contre les cibles avec plus de PV restants, jusqu'à un maximum de 121 de puissance.

shadow-force.name: Shadow Force
shadow-force.description: Le lanceur disparaît, évitant toutes les attaques, et frappe au prochain tour.  Touche à travers Abri et Détection.

lunar-dance.name: Lunar Dance
lunar-dance.description: Le lanceur est mis KO, et son remplaçant est complètement soigné.

heart-swap.name: Heart Swap
heart-swap.description: Le lanceur et la cible échangent leurs changements de stat.

seed-flare.name: Seed Flare
seed-flare.description: A une $probabilité_d'effet% de chances de diminuer la Défense Spéciale de la cible de de deux niveaux.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.description: Si le lanceur tient une plaque ou module approprié, les dégâts infligés y correspondent.

searing-shot.name: Searing Shot
searing-shot.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.

v-create.name: V-create
v-create.description: Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

steel-roller.name: Steel Roller
steel-roller.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

crafty-shield.name: Crafty Shield
crafty-shield.description: Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves.

corrosive-gas.name: Corrosive Gas
corrosive-gas.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

night-daze.name: Night Daze
night-daze.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

horn-leech.name: Horn Leech
horn-leech.description: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

rising-voltage.name: Rising Voltage
rising-voltage.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

strength-sap.name: Strength Sap
strength-sap.description: Heals the user by the target’s current Attack stat and lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

shift-gear.name: Shift Gear
shift-gear.description: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.

gear-up.name: Gear Up
gear-up.description: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with plus or minus by one stage.

first-impression.name: First Impression
first-impression.description: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle.

head-charge.name: Head Charge
head-charge.description: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

fire-lash.name: Fire Lash
fire-lash.description: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.

fiery-dance.name: Fiery Dance
fiery-dance.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

blue-flare.name: Blue Flare
blue-flare.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.

fusion-flare.name: Fusion Flare
fusion-flare.description: With Fusion Bolt, inflicts double damage.

bolt-strike.name: Bolt Strike
bolt-strike.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to paralyze the target.

fusion-bolt.name: Fusion Bolt
fusion-bolt.description: With Fusion Flare, inflicts double damage.

glaciate.name: Glaciate
glaciate.description: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

secret-sword.name: Secret Sword
secret-sword.description: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.

relic-song.name: Relic Song
relic-song.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to put the target to sleep.

techno-blast.name: Techno Blast
techno-blast.description: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.

parting-shot.name: Parting Shot
parting-shot.description: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage.  Makes the user switch out.

kings-shield.name: King’s Shield
kings-shield.description: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact.  Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

aromatic-mist.name: Aromatic Mist
aromatic-mist.description: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.description: Changes the target’s move’s type to electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.

parabolic-charge.name: Parabolic Charge
parabolic-charge.description: Heals the user for half the total damage dealt to all targets.

flying-press.name: Flying Press
flying-press.description: Deals both fighting and flying-type damage.

fairy-lock.name: Fairy Lock
fairy-lock.description: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.

branch-poke.name: Branch Poke
branch-poke.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

forests-curse.name: Forest’s Curse
forests-curse.description: Adds grass to the target’s types.

trick-or-treat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trick-or-treat.description: Adds ghost to the target’s types.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.description: Takes one turn to charge, then raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages.

terrain-pulse.name: Terrain Pulse
terrain-pulse.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

oblivion-wing.name: Oblivion Wing
oblivion-wing.description: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

core-enforcer.name: Core Enforcer
core-enforcer.description: Nullifies the target’s ability if it moves earlier.

lands-wrath.name: Land’s Wrath
lands-wrath.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

thousand-arrows.name: Thousand Arrows
thousand-arrows.description: Grounds the target, and hits even Flying-type or levitating Pokémon.

thousand-waves.name: Thousand Waves
thousand-waves.description: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

diamond-storm.name: Diamond Storm
diamond-storm.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise the user’s Defense by two stages for each target hit.

steam-eruption.name: Steam Eruption
steam-eruption.description: Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.
